chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 41: Ji Ning Awakens Divine Sense & Breaks to Xiantian
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning discovers his Divine Sense, uses the Water-Fire Lotus to kill Tie Muzhan, and breaks through to Xiantian in both Ki Refining and Body Refining. He finally unlocks his mother’s forbidden manual.
og_title: Divine Sense Awakens – Ji Ning’s First Kill as a Xiantian
og_description: Ji Ning discovers his Divine Sense, uses the Water-Fire Lotus to kill the century-old hunter Tie Muzhan, and breaks through to Xiantian in both paths. He finally opens the Windwing Evasion manual.
twitter_title: Ji Ning Kills Tie Muzhan & Wakes Divine Sense!
